title: Development and External Validation of a Machine Learning-Derived Risk Stratification Score for Metastatic Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer.
summary: The PROGRESS machine-learning-derived score stratified overall-survival risk in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer and was evaluated in two independent patient datasets.
ai_technology: Methods describe patient datasets, model development and statistical analyses; Results report generation of the score and validation in two patient cohorts.
